title: The transcendence of π
abstract: Formalizes a self-contained proof, following Niven's 1939 argument, that the real and complex number π is transcendental over the rationals.

informal.IsTranscendentalPi: Proves that the complex number π is transcendental over ℚ.
informal.IsTranscendentalPiReal: Proves that the real number π is transcendental over ℚ.
informal.isAlgebraic_I_mul_pi_of_isAlgebraic_pi: Shows that if π is algebraic over ℚ then so is iπ.
informal.exists_monic_rat_poly_aeval_Ipi_eq_zero: Produces a monic rational polynomial vanishing at iπ when iπ is algebraic.
